entries.02b78bd34005c7f9: Headquartered in Toyota City, Aichi Prefecture, the company forms a group with 10 subsidiaries and 4 affiliates, with Toyota Motor Corporation as an other affiliated company. Its main businesses are the manufacture and sale of equipment and automotive parts.
entries.30d02173b3ea2cac: This business manufactures and sells automobile interior and exterior parts. Its main products are center cluster panels, console panels, door switch bases, steering wheels, rocker moldings, and others. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥9,500,008,000 plus ¥8,000,000 plus seventy-nine million nine hundred ninety-two thousand yen.

entries.b18365d08b595f70: This business designs, manufactures, and sells painting plants, painting equipment, and industrial machinery. Its main products are pretreatment equipment, electrodeposition coating equipment, painting booths, air conditioning equipment, drying furnaces, heat treatment furnaces, painting machines and painting systems, and others. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥29,300,007,000 plus ¥1,000,000 plus sixty-nine million nine hundred ninety-three thousand yen.
